summary: Builds and smoke-checks a live-closure external runner packet for the riskiest unfinished work: producing the first real digest-bound TinyLlama trace on a machine with runtime, disk, and network. REV0149 stops copying the entire tools directory; it carries only the active first-real-trace closure plus generated runner scripts, while preserving snapshot download-plan, runtime lock, cache-root, digest-receipt, offline-quarantine, and preflight-handoff gates.

packet_manifest.packet_scope: active TinyLlama public trace runner plus computed live-script closure; no whole tools directory
omitted_on_purpose: idea ledgers and old native probes
trace outputs and receipts that must be generated fresh by the runner

research_basis.fact: huggingface_hub reads environment variables at import time and defines HF_HOME, HF_HUB_CACHE, HF_XET_CACHE, and slow-link timeout controls, so the runner binds project-local cache roots before any Hub import.

huggingface_hub reads environment variables at import time; HF_HUB_OFFLINE prevents HTTP calls and skips the usual cache freshness request, so evidence capture must set it before importing the runtime.
Transformers offline use requires downloaded/cached files ahead of time and supports local_files_only=True from a local directory; this matches the prepare-then-local-capture split.
HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT/HF_HUB_ETAG_TIMEOUT and HF_HUB_OFFLINE are current Hub controls relevant to slow or local-only snapshot materialization.
Transformers offline mode requires files to be downloaded/cached first and supports local_files_only loading from a local directory.

The selected TinyLlama model.safetensors is an Xet-backed 2.2GB file with a published SHA-256, motivating a first-full-hash plus stat-bound reuse contract rather than repeated rehashing in every gate.
TinyLlama is a compact 1.1B model using the Llama 2 architecture/tokenizer family; this supports the Llama-specific trace surface but not any promotion claim.
Hugging Face Hub docs require a full-length commit hash for specific commit downloads and describe snapshot_download at a given revision.
snapshot_download supports filtering/local folders/dry-run, which makes an external runner packet more useful than another top-level registry note.
Transformers exposes attention backend selection through attn_implementation and mask handling is backend-sensitive; trace semantics must stay eager while SDPA/Flash remain timing baselines.
SLSA verification guidance says provenance only matters if consumers inspect it against expectations; external runner receipts must be digest-checked, not merely generated.
Recent artifact-evaluation work frames reproduction as executable scripts and reports finding errors, reinforcing a runner-first repair instead of more doctrine.
Externally-managed Python environments make direct system pip installs a likely external-runner blocker; use project-local virtualenv bootstrap instead.
Modern Hugging Face Hub large-file paths can use hf_xet; older hub clients may need hf-xet installed explicitly.
